senses.gloss:
r. 6th cl. (औ) औणुद (नुदति नुदते)
1 To cast, to command, to direct, to throw or send; the act of ordering being considered analogous to that of throwing.
2 To go or proceed.
With अप,
To remove.
With निर्,
1 To throw out.
2 To confess, to acknowledge.
With वि,
To be happy.
With सं in the causal
To drive, (as horses.)
